brief: A note-taking app in 3D space — recent notes float near, old ones drift away, connections are threads

dominant_strengths: Conceptually ambitious — 3D depth metaphor for note recency is a genuinely novel spatial-memory idea
Dotted thread connections hint at a poetic graph aesthetic with restrained blue accent color
Helper card bottom-left gives clear affordance instructions in a humble, minimal type style
dominant_weaknesses: Composition is catastrophically broken — the primary note card is clipped off-screen top-left, leaving 90% empty void
Typography overlaps and double-renders inside the card, making content illegible and signaling broken 3D text rendering
Threads float disconnected from any visible node, so the core 'connections' metaphor reads as random arcs
fix_priorities: Re-center camera so at least one full note anchors the canvas and threads visibly terminate at nodes
Fix text rendering in 3D — use crisp billboarded labels or SDF type to eliminate the ghosted overlap
Add subtle depth cues (fog, scale falloff, parallax) so 'recent vs old' reads instantly without the helper card
Introduce a focal hierarchy: one hero note sharp, others blurred/faded to sell the dimensional metaphor
rationale.norman_balance: Reflective concept outpaces a broken visceral first impression and unusable behavioral state where nothing is reachable or readable.
rationale.intent_fit: The brief is partially expressed through threads and floating cards, but execution fails — clipping, illegible type, and empty space prevent the dimensional-memory metaphor from landing.
